data.name: Retro Soccer Manager Sim 89
data.detailed_description:
Do you miss the days when a management sim could keep you up all night, armed with nothing but stats, gut instinct, and the theater created in your mind?

Retro Soccer Manager Sim 89 is a tribute to the golden age of management sims, a love letter to text-based immersion. Every week presents a new set of challenges and a deeply satisfying gameplay loop where your decisions truly matter.

Take the helm of a struggling club in a completely fictional and quintessentially British football universe. From the muddy, forgotten pitches of Tier 5, you must lead your team to glory in a world where the names are silly and the stakes are high.

Balanced for "One More Week": We've stripped out the tedious micromanagement to focus on what matters: the big decisions. The gameplay is a finely tuned risk/reward loop designed to be challenging but fair, creating that classic "just one more week" feeling that will keep you up at night plotting your club's future.

A World of Pure Imagination: Manage clubs in a completely fictional, tongue-in-cheek universe. Every team, player, and location is procedurally generated, ensuring every career is a unique and often hilarious journey.

Master the Pitch: Choose from a variety of classic tactics and formations. A detailed match engine simulates every result based on player skill, morale, and your strategic choices.

Build Your Dynasty: Navigate a dynamic transfer market, sign free agents, and develop young talent. Negotiate contracts and manage a full squad of unique, randomly generated players.

Master the Books & Wield the Axe: Juggle a tight wage budget and invest in end of season stadium upgrades to boost your income.  Need a quick cash injection?  Take out a slightly-less-than-reputable loan.  Tired of an underperforming player?  Pay their pesky severance to fire them and immediately unleash your scout on the hunt for fresh talent.  In this club, even your staff isn't safe from getting the boot!

Bet the Club: This isn't your typical, sanitized management sim. Here, the board doesn't just allow you to gamble—they practically encourage it.  Fancy a long shot against the top team?  Wager your entire transfer budget on the result.  Unlimited wagers mean unlimited glory... or a one-way ticket to bankruptcy.

Embrace the Absurd: This is lower-league football, and things get weird.  Face bizarre random events and embrace your destiny.

A Pure Experience: No microtransactions, just a deep, rewarding, and often hilarious football management simulation.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: 2 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10, 11, or 12 capable GPU with at least 1GB of VRAM.
  • Storage: 37 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard Audio
  • VR Support: NA
